title: The 8 Levels of Ex-Profile Stalking
house: A bustling neon-lit metropolis of fruit and vegetable people, filled with damp rainy bus stops, cramped co-living apartments, glowing digital foreheads, and hidden gold coins stamped onto street corners.
links: Level 1 mentions the flickering streetlight outside Grandma's kitchen where Level 5 drops her mail.
Level 2 hears a rumor about an old woman renting out her ancient phone to desperate youth.
Level 3 passes the exact same blue diner booth where Level 7 sits counting her savings.
Level 4 drops his vintage flip phone on the pavement near the kiosk where Level 2 buys chewing gum.
Level 5 leaves her spare house keys with the prickly lemon woman from Level 1.
Level 6 spots a mysterious glowing forehead number flashing from the second-story window of Level 3's apartment.
Level 7 buys her morning coffee from the very same barista who once rejected Level 2.
Level 8 reveals that the grandma whose phone was used belongs to the mastermind of Level 4.

levels.name: Pip, 21, Intern
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 1. 2.000 Abos? Wer hat den Versager denn reingelassen? Vielleicht putzt er gleich die Toiletten für uns Influencer. I am Pip, a 21-year-old strawberry intern living on instant noodles and $1,100 rent. My forehead glows with a pathetic 0.03 views per second rating. Outside, the rain hammers against the dirty window of our cramped kitchenette. For forty minutes, I have been refreshing my ex-boyfriend Leo's new girlfriend's vacation story through Grandma Betty's dusty account. You cannot afford to live here, let alone use the Wi-Fi for stalking. My stomach drops into my shoes as I clutch the greasy phone tighter. Suddenly, a cold draft sweeps across the room, extinguishing the flickering fluorescent bulb overhead. Grandma Betty steps out from the shadows, her wrinkled coconut fingers closing tightly around the cracked screen. You are looking at the wrong profile, honey. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Chloe, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 2. 1.850 Euro im Monat? Du stalkst deinen Ex auf Staatskosten, während er in Dubai den Champagner köpft. I am Chloe, a 24-year-old orange woman working at a noisy downtown café. My forehead shows 1.850 €, just enough to pay for half a studio apartment. You think you are sneaky, using an old lady's phone to watch his stories. My hands shook as I tried to delete the app before he could report me. The café lights flickered, casting long, menacing shadows across the tiled floor. He leaned in closer, his sharp scales brushing against my orange peel skin. He whispered the exact words I feared most. Without warning, the front glass doors slammed open, revealing a towering figure in a sharp suit holding an encrypted laptop. The screen flashed with my exact search history for everyone to see. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Milo, 28, Delivery Driver
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 3. Dein Ex hat dich nicht wegen des Geldes verlassen, sondern weil du jeden Tag seinen Kontostand stalkst wie ein Creep. I am Milo, a 28-year-old avocado man dodging traffic on an electric scooter. My forehead glows with a mediocre 2.400 € digital display. Using Grandma Betty's backup profile let me see that my ex, Maya, checked into a luxury penthouse. Then my phone buzzed with an alert from Grandma's banking app. You are tracking the wrong person, delivery boy. My skin heated up under my green avocado peel as I gripped the handlebar. She knew about the account, the stalking, and everything else. A sleek black car pulled up beside me in the pouring rain, lowering its tinted window to reveal an icy smile. A folder stamped with classified corporate seals slid across the passenger seat toward me. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Zack, 31, Stock Broker
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 4. Mit deinem Gehalt kannst du dir nicht mal die Anwaltskosten leisten, wenn ich deine Suchanfragen veröffentliche. I am Zack, a 31-year-old dragonfruit man sitting in a glass-walled office. My forehead displays 9.420 €, giving me access to high-society circles. Logging into Grandma Betty's shared cloud account revealed my entire search history synced to her device. The door to my office swung open without a warning. You think your money hides your pathetic habits. My scales tightened in pure panic as she dropped a printed folder onto my desk. She leaned over my desk, her acidic smile cutting deep into my pride. A sudden system alert echoed across my monitors, revealing that my entire personal portfolio had just been transferred to an unknown offshore account. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Grandma Betty, 74, Retired
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 5. Jeder von euch stalkt in Wahrheit die Person, die ihn gerade ruiniert hat. I am Betty, a 74-year-old coconut woman sitting in my rocking chair. My forehead shines with a staggering 45.000 € earned from leasing burner accounts. Pip, Chloe, Milo, Zack—they all used my old phone thinking they were being clever. A heavy knock rattled my front door as a mysterious visitor stepped inside. You've built quite an empire on broken hearts, Grandma. My wooden rocking chair creaked to a halt as I narrowed my eyes. He tossed a velvet pouch onto my lap and whispered a dark secret. Before I could answer, the floorboards beneath us gave way, revealing a massive underground control center that connected every single stalker in the city. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Madame Citron, 42, Executive
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 6. Deine Arroganz hält genau so lange, bis dein gesamter Suchverlauf auf dem Screen deiner Chefin landet. I am Citron, a 42-year-old lemon woman ruling the corporate banking sector. My forehead glows with 18.500 €, a badge of absolute untouchable power. Using Grandma Betty's master network to check my ex's profile triggered a live feed on my TV. The intercom buzzed aggressively as a trembling delivery boy appeared on a livestream. You think your lemon-sour attitude hides your loneliness. My acidic skin tingled with blinding rage as I dropped my crystal wine glass. He held up a handwritten envelope with my maiden name written across it. Right behind him on the broadcast, my entire bank account balance plummeted to zero in real time. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Beatrix, 50, Investor
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 7. Du kaufst kaputte Startups, aber deine eigene Beziehung hast du längst weggeworfen. I am Beatrix, a 50-year-old broccoli woman buying failing startups. My forehead glows with a solid 12.500 €, earned through cold precision. Grandma Betty's network flagged an unauthorized access attempt on my private terminal. An avocado delivery driver marched straight into my executive boardroom. You can buy companies, Beatrix, but you can't buy closure. My florets tightened in disbelief as he dropped a battered delivery bag on my table. He leaned over the table and dropped the final warning before the system locked out. A blinding red emergency light flashed across the glass walls as every terminal in the building downloaded an encrypted file titled 'Project Ex'. You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: The Architect, 35, System Admin
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-profile stalking. Level 8. Die Zahl auf deiner Stirn zeigt nur, wie einsam du wirklich bist. I am the Architect, a smooth coconut man sitting in the central server room. My forehead displays an infinite looping symbol as the creator of Grandma Betty's network. Every time someone checked an ex's story, my algorithm recorded their exact heartbeat. Today, all eight levels converged on my underground bunker. You built a kingdom on curiosity. Grandma Betty placed a single golden coin onto my control console. Das siehst du in Level 8. With a final keystroke, the main server emitted a deafening pulse, wiping all digital identities and plunging the entire metropolis into total darkness. You'll see that in Level 8.
